extraction_warnings: PDF source uses 8-digit codes without dots (e.g., '09011111'). Normalized to NNNN.NN.NN format (e.g., '0901.11.11') per project schema. Subheading numbers in PDF (e.g., '090111') normalized to NNNN.NN (e.g., '0901.11').

PDF contains '?' characters in place of typographic quote marks in the Export Licensing Notes (e.g., '?Spice?' and '?masalas?'). These are OCR/encoding artifacts from the source PDF — preserved verbatim as they appear in the source. The intended text is 'Spice' and 'masalas' enclosed in quotation marks.

The chapter title on PDF page 1 is rendered as 'Chapter 09 Coffee, Tea, Mat And Spices.' — the official ITC(HS) chapter title is 'COFFEE, TEA, MATÉ AND SPICES' (heading 0903 in the chapter is 'Maté'). Title field uses the canonical form with diacritic; source_pdf field preserves the abbreviated filename form.

PDF table-chrome headers ('Sl.No. Notes Notification No Notification Date', 'Itc(hs) Code. Description Export Policy Policy Condition', 'Main Notes', 'Policy Condition', 'Export Licensing Notes', 'Product Description and Export Policy') were recognized as table headers and EXCLUDED from the legal notes per extraction rules.

Heading 0903 ('Maté') is represented in the PDF as the single tariff line '09030000' with description 'Mate'. No subheading row appears in the source; tariff line is attached directly under the heading. The accented spelling 'Maté' is reflected in the chapter title; the heading description in the PDF reads 'Mate' (without accent) and is preserved verbatim.
Heading 0904 description in PDF reads 'Pepper of the genus Piper; dried or crushed or ground fruits of the genus Capsicum or of the genus Pimenta.' — verbatim, including the trailing period.
Section II Main Note about 'pellets' appears on PDF page 1 above the Chapter 09 title and is attributed to section_notes (Section II, Vegetable Products), not chapter_notes.

Tariff line code '09092200' represents subheading 0909.22 with tariff suffix '00' — preserved as the 8-digit form '0909.22.00' under subheading '0909.22'. Similar pattern for '09030000', '09011200', '09081200', '09082100', '09082200', '09051000', '09052000', '09062000', '09072000', '09093200' — all are 8-digit codes where the subheading has only one tariff line (the '00' line).

Policy Condition: tariff lines from heading 0904 onwards display 'Subject to Policy Condition 1 of the Chapter' with Notification No '32/2015-20' dated '04.10.2017'. This is captured in the policy_conditions array.

chapter_notes.text: Mixtures of the products of headings 0904 to 0910 are to be classified as follows: (a) mixtures of two or more of the products of the same heading are to be classified in that heading; (b) mixtures of two or more of the products of different headings are to be classified in heading 0910. The addition of other substances to the products of headings 0904 to 0910 [or to the mixtures referred to in paragraph (a) or (b) above] shall not affect their classification provided the resulting mixtures retain the essential character of the goods of those heading. Otherwise such mixtures are not classified in this Chapter; those constituting mixed condiments or mixed seasonings are classified in heading 2103.
This Chapter does not cover Cubeb pepper (Piper cubeba) or other products of heading 1211.

section_notes.text: In this Section, the term "pellets" means products which have been agglomerated either directly by compression or by the addition of a binder in a proportion not exceeding 3 (percent) by weight.
